name: Ray-Cube Intersection (Brick/Slab)
aliases: Hardware Ray Tracing Voxel Primary Hit Resolution
definition: An Amanatides-Woo DDA within one brick's 4x4x4 voxels to find the first solid voxel a ray crosses. It returns the time `t` of the entry face of the first solid voxel found in `[t_lo, t_hi]`, or -1 if no solid voxel is hit.
